arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import native, layout, fib, main as M
from protocol import parse_request
cases=parse_request(open('/workspace/tmp/fail1.json','rb').read())
native.try_build()
for ci,case in enumerate(cases):
    versions=fib.publish(case["initial"],case["transactions"])
    print("case",ci,"R",[len(v[0]) for v in versions], "budget",case["cache_pages"])
    per=[[] for _ in versions]
    for version,repeat,addresses in case["bursts"]:
        starts=versions[version][0]
        per[version].append((repeat,[fib.run_index(starts,a) for a in addresses]))
    costs=case["costs"]
    lay=native.plan(versions,per,costs,case["cache_pages"])
    bad=0
    for i,(starts,hops) in enumerate(versions):
        nodes=lay[i]
        if not M.check_layout(starts,hops,nodes):
            bad+=1
            print("  v",i,"REJECTED")
            for n in nodes[:8]:
                print("     ",n, "legal", layout.legal(n,starts))
            print("   starts",[hex(s) for s in starts][:20])
    if bad: break
